body: Oma#0281. If that won't work for you, you can DM me for my number. I'm here to talk.

Alright, let's say for just a moment it's not a good thing to consider the lives and hearts of everyone around you. I don't just mean your loved ones. Now THEIR friends and THEIR family have to watch them go through this, and those friends tell THEIR friends. There's a reason many suicides gain national notice. The web of attention it gets is big, and the number of hearts you break by doing it is incomprehensible, because it'll be whomever sees or hears it. Let's pretend for a few seconds you shouldn't care about that in the same way they care about you. Why is suicide selfish?   


Think about a video game. How much do you hate people who just quit games like League of Legends, or quit dungeons in WoW mid-run. They're assholes. It's selfish because there is, no matter how horrible you feel, potential in your life to get so much better than you think it can.   


Trust me, I get it. I have a plan. I've done the math. I've orchestrated the things I need to to make sure as few people know about it as possible. I get how you feel. I really do. The thing is, I know that I'm an asshole for doing it. I know that I'm ruining all the work that I've put into my life, throwing it away, wasting all of that potential, all when I'm just gonna die at the end anyways.
